title: How do deals work?
question: I see a 'Deals Only' filter. How do I redeem a deal and do they expire?
author: Ava (ava@bytesized.app)

replies.author: Noah (noah@bytesized.app)
replies.message: Deals are posted by businesses and include an expiration date. Tap the business, open the Deals section, and follow the instructions listed with the offer.

replies.author: Mia (mia@bytesized.app)
replies.message: If the deal is expired it won't be useful anymore—so I usually check the expiration line before going.

replies.author: raghavrhino2829@outlook.com
replies.message: If the deal doesn't work it's not useful - make sure you check the date

title: Why do I need an account to favorite?
question: Can I browse without signing up? And why does Favorites require login?
author: Ethan (ethan@bytesized.app)

replies.author: Sophia (sophia@bytesized.app)
replies.message: You can browse, but favorites and reviews are tied to your profile so they persist and can't be spoofed.

title: How are ratings calculated?
question: Is the rating an average of all reviews or something else?
author: Liam (liam@bytesized.app)

replies.author: Olivia (olivia@bytesized.app)
replies.message: It’s the average of all star ratings for that business. If a review is deleted the average updates.

title: Location filter tips
question: What should I type in Town/ZIP to find places near me in Union County?
author: Isabella (isabella@bytesized.app)

replies.author: Lucas (lucas@bytesized.app)
replies.message: Either type a town like 'Westfield' or a ZIP like '07090'. It matches the address text.
